headline: Purchasing and Inventory Assistant
summary: Former warehouse inventory staff who has moved into purchasing at the same distribution company. After three years counting, storing and issuing stock, I now raise purchase orders, process branch orders and follow up deliveries. Knowing the warehouse helps me order the right quantities at the right time.

experience.title: Purchasing and Inventory Assistant
experience.employer: Ortigas Home and Office Supplies Distribution
bullets: Prepare about 120 purchase orders a month from approved requests and reorder reports.
Process replenishment orders from 18 branches and confirm dispatch dates with the warehouse.
Follow up late deliveries with suppliers and update the incoming-stock list daily.

experience.title: Warehouse Inventory Staff
experience.employer: Ortigas Home and Office Supplies Distribution
bullets: Counted, labelled and stored incoming stock and picked branch orders.
Ran cycle counts and investigated variances with the inventory controller.
Kept aisles and racks safe by following stacking limits and clearing damaged stock.

education.credential: Diploma in Logistics and Supply Chain Operations
